Algebra 1 · Unit 1: Foundations of Algebra

Order of Operations

Apply the agreed order (grouping, exponents, multiplication and division, addition and subtraction) so every expression has one value.

What you’ll learn

  • Simplify numerical expressions using the order of operations
  • Work with parentheses, brackets and fraction bars
  • Find and fix order-of-operations mistakes

The mountain biking connection

Total climbing = laps × (gain per lap) + warm-up climb. Doing the steps in the right order gives the right total.
